user.title: Connect to mijn.host
user.description: Keeps one A record at mijn.host pointed at this network's public IPv4 address. The API key is stored inside Home Assistant and can be replaced later via re-authentication.

reauth_confirm.title: Update mijn.host API key
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key was rejected by mijn.host. Enter a new key.

reconfigure.title: Replace mijn.host API key
reconfigure.description: Enter the new API key. Remember to also update the expiry date in the integration options.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the mijn.host API (check the domain spelling)
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs

abort.already_configured: This record is already managed by another entry

data.warn_days: Warn this many days before expiry

error.custom_url_required: Enter an https:// URL that returns a bare IPv4 address

key_expiry.title: mijn.host API key expires soon
key_expiry.description: The API key used for {record} expires on {date} ({days} days left). Create a new key in the mijn.host control panel, then replace it via the integration's Reconfigure action (Settings → Devices & Services → mijn.host DDNS → ⋮ → Reconfigure) and update the expiry date in its options.
